blocks.text: It's Axel, and I wrote this one myself
I'm Axel. I started this store to make one thing easier: protecting a caravan, motorhome or RV while it's parked.
We sell two things. A roof cover that keeps rainwater off the roof hatches and seams. A windshield cover that keeps the cold and sun off the glass and blacks out the cab.
You'll hear from us again, but only when there's something worth saying.

Reply if you're wondering about anything. I read these myself.
Axel, founder
